motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Existing button color feedback; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary action
components.css: .ds-primary{font:16px/1.65 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;background:var(--action,#006b65);color:#fff;border:1px solid var(--action,#006b65);border-radius:6px;padding:10px 18px;min-height:44px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s;}.ds-primary:hover{background:#004f4b;}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #188a84;outline-offset:3px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none;}}

components.name: Text field
components.css: .ds-label{font:16px/1.65 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;display:block;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink,#142d40);}.ds-input{font:16px/1.65 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;display:block;margin-top:6px;background:white;color:var(--ink,#142d40);border:1px solid #8c9ea6;border-radius:6px;padding:10px 12px;min-height:44px;caret-color:var(--action,#006b65);}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #188a84;outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Current navigation
components.html: 내 작업
components.css: .ds-current{font:16px/1.65 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;padding:8px 0;text-decoration:none;color:var(--action,#006b65);font-weight:750;border-bottom:2px solid var(--action,#006b65);}.ds-current:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #188a84;outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Record row
components.css: .ds-row{font:16px/1.65 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;padding:24px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#d4dfe3);color:var(--ink,#142d40);}.ds-row p{color:var(--muted,#4c626c);}

narrative.overview: White content, navy text and teal actions organize hospital search, reservation, personal records and administration. Neutral summary areas separate supporting information from the next task. The source JSP presentation and synthetic compatibility workspace use the same color roles but retain their own layout selectors.
donts: Do not imply production success from synthetic state.
Do not claim visual verification without rendering.
